title: CustomRecipes
description: Create your own custom recipe for any item!
body:

✨ Key Features
- 100% In-Game GUI: Create and edit recipes using the native Minecraft Workbench interface. No more typing item IDs into config files!
- Full Custom Item Support: The plugin perfectly reads NBT Data, enchantments, lore, custom model data, and names.

Commands & Permissions
- /cr setrecipe - sets the recipe for the item (1 recipe)
- /cr addrecipe - adds another recipe for the item (infinity recipes)
- /cr items - (see all the custom recipes)
